data.title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager
data.description:
About Payscale

Payscale is the pioneer of compensation intelligence, helping organizations make smarter pay decisions that drive business performance. For more than 20 years, Payscale has combined trusted market data with AI-powered technology to deliver actionable insights that turn pay from a cost into a catalyst for growth. The Payscale Intelligence Cloud portfolio of solutions — Ascent, JobNav, and Paycycle — empower top companies and businesses like Cintas, Leidos, Chipotle, Ohio State University, and TJX Companies.

Create confidence in your compensation. Payscale.

To learn more, visit www.payscale.com.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Revenue Enablement Manager to design, implement, and optimize scalable learning programs that drive revenue impact and organizational effectiveness. This role sits at the intersection of execution and strategy—you will own enablement initiatives end-to-end while beginning to shape broader enablement frameworks and business strategy. Reporting to Director, Solutions Consulting & Enablement, you will partner with Revenue organization, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to diagnose performance gaps, deliver targeted solutions, and measure impact.

What You'll Do

Enablement Strategy & Program Design

  • Design and launch scalable enablement programs and learning initiatives that directly impact sales productivity, product adoption, and customer retention

  • Develop specialized expertise in learning methodologies and engagement techniques; apply these to assess organizational performance gaps and recommend targeted solutions

  • Design and contribute to onboarding programs for new Revenue team members, including curriculum development, content creation, facilitation, practice activities, and ongoing reinforcement

  • Establish or refine enablement frameworks that align with quarterly business goals and annual company strategy

  • Conduct formal training needs assessments using surveys, data analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify root causes of performance shortfalls

  • Create comprehensive enablement roadmaps with clear timelines, success metrics, and resource requirements

Revenue & Business Impact

  • Measure and communicate the revenue impact of enablement programs; link training initiatives directly to key sales outcomes (pipeline, win rates, quota attainment)

  • Analyze enablement effectiveness through data; design and implement KPIs to track adoption, completion, and performance outcomes

  • Proactively review company goals and revenue metrics to identify enablement gaps and improvement opportunities

  • Collaborate with leadership to define enablement priorities and ROI; recommend program adjustments based on business results

  • Connect enablement efforts to competitive positioning and market dynamics

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

  • Lead cross-functional teams to develop content, run workshops, and deliver training at scale

  • Navigate competing enablement priorities between Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success; build influence to resolve adoption friction

  • Manage stakeholder expectations and feedback loops; synthesize input from end-users and partners to continuously improve programs

  • Partner with L&D, HR, and People teams on organizational change management for major enablement launches

  • Coordinate with Product and Marketing on go-to-market enablement for new features and product launches

Change Management & Adoption

  • Design and execute change management strategies for major enablement initiatives

  • Measure adoption and engagement; identify and address barriers to adoption through dialogue and data-driven problem-solving

  • Coach team members and stakeholders on program changes; deliver constructive feedback on enablement effectiveness

  • Demonstrate strong organizational change management capabilities to drive adoption and organizational alignment

Content & Technical Excellence

  • Create and oversee development of enablement content across formats: e-learning, presentations, guides, video, and knowledge management systems

  • Use advanced analytics and reporting to assess training impact and identify trends

  • Integrate and optimize the enablement technology stack (LMS, CRM, knowledge bases), leveraging automation and AI-powered solutions to increase personalization and efficiency

  • Maintain documentation standards and processes that scale as the enablement function grows

We'd love to talk with you if you have:

  • 5-7 years of experience in enablement, training, learning & development, revenue operations, or related field

  • Demonstrated expertise in designing and launching training programs that have improved sales or business outcomes

  • Strong analytical skills; comfort with data reporting, performance metrics, and using insights to drive decisions

  • Excellent collaboration and influence skills; ability to navigate cross-functional environments and competing priorities

  • Proficiency with enablement tools (LMS, CRM, knowledge management platforms) and data analytics; experience with Gong, Claude, Seismic a plus

  • Experience conducting needs assessments and diagnosing root causes of performance gaps

  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail

  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with demonstrated experience delivering engaging training, workshops, and practice-based sessions to both small and large audiences

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present

Nice to Have

  • Experience with change management frameworks and stakeholder engagement strategies

  • Background in sales, product, or customer-facing functions (to deepen product/market understanding)

  • Familiarity with Revenue tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, Nooks, and related best practices to drive tool adoption and performance

  • Track record of implementing new tools, platforms, or processes

  • Knowledge of sales methodologies, buyer journeys, or go-to-market strategy

  • Project management certification or experience leading large-scale organizational initiatives

Location

Payscale has an employee centric remote-first model that provides you the flexibility to do your best work in a space that supports you, while also finding time to collaborate in person for the moments that matter.

In our remote-first model, employees can work from the location that works best for them. We do not have centralized corporate offices. Employees can choose to work from home, in company-paid co-working spaces, or any combination of the two that best suits their unique needs.

If you work from home, we recommend ensuring that you can meet the following technology, equipment and workspace requirements:

  • High-Speed Internet - A stable broadband or fiber connection (satellite is highly discouraged) with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps in a dedicated workspace that has a reliable Wi-Fi signal.

  • Device for Multifactor Authentication (MFA/2FA) - smartphone, tablet, etc.

When it matters (usually no more than a few times a year) we take the time to gather for in-person events.

Payscale has employees across the US, Canada, UK, The Philippines and Romania however we are currently unable to hire in the Quebec Province, Northern Ireland, and Hawaii.

Benefits and Perks

All around awesome culture where together we strive to live our 5 values:

  • Data informed decision making.

  • Customer first. Always.

  • Succeed together.

  • Relentless about results. Obsessed with excellence.

  • Lead the change. Shape the standard.

An open and inclusive environment where you’ll learn and grow through programs and resources like:

  • Monthly company All Hands meetings

  • Regular opportunities for executive leadership exposure through things like AMAs

  • Access to continued learning & development opportunities

  • Our commitment to a continuous feedback culture which allows us to drive performance and career growth

  • A growing network of Employee Resource Groups

  • Company sponsored volunteer hours

  • And more!

Our more standard benefits

  • Flexible paid time off, giving you the opportunity to rest, relax and recharge away from work

  • 14 Paid Company Holidays, includes 2 floating holidays (you choose!)

  • A comprehensive benefits plan including medical, dental, life, vision, disability, and life insurance covered up to 100% by Payscale

  • Unlimited infertility coverage benefits through our medical plans

  • Additional supplemental health benefits offered to you and your family

  • 401(k) retirement program with a fully vested immediate company match

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) options and company contributions each pay period

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options for pre-tax employee allocations

  • Annual remote work stipend to be used on wellness or home office equipment

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We embrace equal employment opportunity. Payscale is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. It is our policy that employees will not be subjected to unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, marital status, sexual orientation, political ideology, and any other basis protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to: recruitment, hiring, transfers, promotions, training, discipline, termination, compensation and benefits, performance appraisals, education, and social and recreational programs.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

If you have a disability or impairment and need assistance with the application process, please email recruiting@payscale.com for support.

Fraud Alert:

Payscale values security and privacy. During your job application and interview process, we will never ask for your personal banking or financial information, social security number, or other sensitive information, if you are unsure if a message is from Payscale, please email recruiting@payscale.com

data.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

  • 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans

  • 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  • Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  • 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

  • Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

  • $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

  • Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

  • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

  • Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager, Product Enablement to build the enablement engine behind our fastest-growing product lines: Cloud Compute and Cloud GPU. The ideal candidate is a technical enablement expert with 5+ years of experience turning complex infrastructure products into content, training, and tools that sales and customer-facing teams actually use — someone who thrives in a category that reinvents itself every few months. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require the ability to build recurring enablement cadences from scratch, partner directly with Product and Engineering, and keep pace with a GPU and AI infrastructure market that never sits still. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and own a recurring product enablement program for Vultr's Cloud Compute and Cloud GPU portfolios, from new feature launches to monthly deep-dives

  • Translate complex, fast-changing technical capabilities (GPU architectures, compute instance types, infrastructure roadmaps) into sales-ready messaging, training, and collateral

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to get early visibility into roadmaps and turn upcoming releases into enablement content before GA

  • Design and deliver certification paths, playbooks, and live/on-demand training that scale enablement across a growing go-to-market org

  • Develop competitive positioning and battle cards for the Cloud Compute and GPU markets, keeping pace with a rapidly evolving AI infrastructure landscape

  • Measure and report on enablement program effectiveness (adoption, certification completion, win rates) and iterate based on data

  • Act as the connective tissue between Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success on all things product knowledge

  • Continuously evolve enablement formats and cadence to match the speed of Vultr's product velocity

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product enablement, technical enablement, or product marketing, ideally supporting a technical or infrastructure-based product line

  • Proven track record building and scaling recurring enablement programs from the ground up

  • Deep comfort with technical products. Able to learn GPU/compute infrastructure concepts quickly and translate them for non-technical audiences

  • Experience in cloud infrastructure, AI/ML infrastructure, or adjacent technical industries strongly preferred

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience creating sales collateral, training curricula, and certification programs

  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities

  • Experience with enablement platforms/LMS tools and sales tech stacks (e.g., Gong, Seismic, Salesforce) a plus

Compensation

$115,000 – $130,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

data.title: Product & Customer Marketing Manager
data.description:
About the role

Our customers have the best stories in accounting, and we need someone to tell them. We're looking for a Product and Customer Marketing Manager who owns our story end to end: how we launch, how we sell, and how our customers talk about us; from launch messaging to the customer proof that wins deals. Aiwyn is the platform accounting firms run on for payments, practice management, client experience, and tax, and we work with the majority of the Top 500 firms in the country. You'll turn what our customers and product teams know into messaging, launches, and proof that helps sales win and helps firms get more from Aiwyn.

You'll partner daily with the growth marketing manager, sales, and product: you find the story and sharpen the message, and they take it to market at scale.

What you'll do:

You'll own product launches, messaging, enablement, and customer marketing across our four products. A week in the life might include:

  • Tiering an upcoming release and writing the launch brief that Product, Sales, CS, and Marketing all work from

  • Interviewing a firm's leadership team about what changed after going live, and pulling out the proof points for a case study

  • Building a message map for a new feature and testing it with the sales team

  • Running an enablement session on a launch, then updating the pitch deck and one-pagers

  • Refreshing competitive battlecards after a deal review

  • Managing our customer reference program so sales always has the right firm to call

  • Drafting a launch press release or an award submission

  • Ghostwriting a LinkedIn post or byline for one of our executives

  • Bringing what you hear from customers back to Product so it shows up on the roadmap

  • Writing the internal launch announcement so every team knows what shipped and why it matters

How you'll make an impact: You'll own outcomes that show up in the business: win rate, product adoption, and how consistently our message lands in the field. We'll be clear about the goals and just as invested in helping you reach them.


What we're looking for:

You have 4 plus years of product and customer marketing experience in B2B SaaS, and you've owned launches from brief to enablement to results. You're as comfortable interviewing a managing partner as you are sitting in a product review, and you can take a complex feature and explain, in one sentence, why a busy firm leader should care.

Customer marketing is part of who you are. You know how to find a great story, earn a customer's trust to tell it, and turn it into proof sales uses every week.

Strong writing is essential. You'll write message maps, launch briefs, enablement content, press releases, and executive posts, and each one needs its own voice.

Requirements:

  • 4 plus years of product and/or customer marketing experience in B2B SaaS

  • A track record of owning product launches end-to-end, including tiering, messaging, and sales enablement

  • Customer marketing experience with case studies, references, advocacy, or customer advisory programs

  • Experience marketing to back-office buyers such as finance, operations, or accounting (accounting or professional services experience is a strong plus)

  • Writing and storytelling samples you're proud to share

  • Experience building competitive intelligence and battlecards

  • Comfort presenting to sales teams and customers

  • AI tools are part of how you work every day, and you can walk us through your workflow

  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Canva

  • Startup experience preferred, but not required

What to expect

You'll report to our director of marketing and work with Product, Sales, and Customer Success every week. We're a small, high-performing team, and it shows in how we work: the pace is quick, priorities shift as we learn what's working, and everyone contributes beyond their lane.

You'll fit right in if you love a good launch day, get a kick out of hearing a customer describe a win in their own words, and want your work to show up in closed deals. We're building something meaningful alongside our customers, and we'd love for you to help shape how the world hears about it.

Benefits and Perks:

  • The big-picture value proposition of this role is simple: join us, and you'll be paid competitively to have freedom in solving worthwhile, challenging problems alongside other A-players at a fast growing SaaS startup led by an experienced and successful co-founding team with industry experience.

Other benefits include:

  1. Adventure travel stipend - you receive a $1,000 travel reimbursement on your work anniversary each year. We encourage our team to recharge and explore the world beyond their home office walls.

  2. Remote, work-from-anywhere culture

  3. Flexible PTO

  4. World Class health benefits - we believe in fostering flourishing teams by providing benefits that go beyond the usual standards - Health, vision, dental, HSA/FSA, and mental health support.

  5. Stock options - every Full Time Employee has ownership in Aiwyn's future and success.

  6. 401(k) matching

Our Values:

  • Relentless by Design

  • Owners not Renters

  • Trust at the Core

Aiwyn is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our CCPA privacy notice which can be found here: https://www.aiwyn.ai/ccpa

data.title: Sales Enablement Specialist
data.description:
About 7AI

7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.

Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.

Overview

7AI is building the onboarding program for a sales team that's still writing its own playbook. As our Sales Enablement Specialist, you'll own onboarding for every new Account Executive and Sales Engineer, turning what our sales leaders, SEs, and product team know into curriculum, learning paths, and certifications people can actually use. You'll build the reporting that shows whether it worked, not just whether reps sat through it. This is a build role: expect to ship a first version fast, watch what happens in Gong and Salesforce, and improve it in the field rather than waiting for a finished program.

What You'll Do

  • Build and run the onboarding program for new AEs and SEs, working from the structure and priorities you set with the Head of Strategy & Enablement.

  • Turn subject matter expertise from sales leadership, SEs, and product into structured curriculum, role-based learning paths, and certifications.

  • Instrument ramp metrics in Salesforce and build the reporting that shows whether onboarding is working.

  • Use Gong and Salesforce to surface coaching gaps and skill patterns, and bring recommendations for what to build next.

  • Maintain the enablement content library and keep it current as the product and market move.

  • Support launch readiness and ongoing enablement programming for the existing team.

  • Partner with SE leadership so AE and SE onboarding stay one coordinated program.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or sales/revenue operations.

  • You've built a program, process, or curriculum from a blank page, on your own or as the primary builder under a more senior owner, and can walk through it end to end.

  • You're comfortable turning other people's expertise into something teachable. Most of the security and product content here will come from our sales leaders, SEs, and product team.

  • You can build the reporting behind a metric and explain what it tells you. You can answer "did this change rep behavior" with evidence, not just a completion rate.

  • You're fluent with AI tooling in a build context: building repeatable workflows, not just occasional prompting.

  • You'd rather ship a v1 into the field and iterate than wait for a finished program.

  • You're curious about security. No prior cybersecurity experience required, but you're ready to go deep on our product and buyer in the first 90 days.

  • You thrive at a company still writing its own playbook.

data.description:
About OpenRouter

OpenRouter is the open AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power some of the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.

As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.


About the Role

As a Solutions Architect, you'll be the technical backbone of our sales organization — partnering with Business Development Managers and Product Managers to translate complex customer requirements into winning technical strategy. You'll work directly with engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams at our largest prospects and customers, helping them understand how to architect, integrate, and scale their LLM usage on OpenRouter.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role. You'll run technical discovery, lead architecture conversations, build and support proofs of concept, and be the trusted technical voice in complex, multi-stakeholder deals — while also feeding what you learn back into Product and Engineering to make OpenRouter better.


What You'll Do

  • Own the technical side of the sales cycle. Partner with Business Development Managers and Product Managers on strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical discovery, solution design, and architecture discussions with customer engineering and infrastructure teams.

  • Run and support proofs of concept. Scope POCs with customers, help them stand up integrations, troubleshoot issues in real time, and drive POCs to a clear technical win.

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions. Understand a customer's infrastructure, model usage, and constraints, and map them to the right OpenRouter architecture, routing strategy, and deployment approach.

  • Be the credible technical voice in the room. Build trust with engineers, architects, and technical decision-makers by speaking their language — on compute, networking, security, and infrastructure as well as on LLMs.

  • Support deal strategy. Help Business Development Managers and Product Managersand account teams navigate technical objections, security reviews, and procurement requirements that come up in enterprise and infrastructure deals.

  • Build reusable technical assets. Create demos, reference architectures, POC frameworks, and technical enablement content the broader sales team can use.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering to bring customer and market signal back into the roadmap, and to make sure customer feedback shapes what we build next.

  • Stay technically sharp. Keep pace with the fast-evolving LLM landscape — new models, providers, infrastructure patterns, and the tools your customers are already using.


What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in a technical, customer-facing role in B2B SaaS — as a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or senior technical Account Executive — with a strong track record supporting complex enterprise deals.

  • Deep experience with developer-centric infrastructure: cloud, Kubernetes, virtualization, networking, storage, or open-source infrastructure platforms.

  • Comfort going deep with technical stakeholders (engineers, architects, infrastructure teams) as well as business stakeholders, and the ability to move fluidly between the two.

  • A track record of driving technical wins in the sales cycle — POCs, architecture reviews, security reviews — that translate into closed business.

  • Strong hands-on technical curiosity: you build things, break things, and stay current because you want to, not just because the job requires it.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience operating in a fast-growing, evolving environment where product, process, and priorities shift as the company scales.


Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, hardened/secure images, or private cloud infrastructure.

  • Personal projects involving AI agents, self-hosted models, or infrastructure tinkering (e.g., running models or VMs on home lab hardware like a Raspberry Pi).

  • Experience selling or supporting sales into healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience building technical enablement or POC programs from scratch at an early-stage or high-growth company.

  • Familiarity with the LLM ecosystem (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source models) and multi-provider routing concepts.

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

Skydio is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineering leader to join our team as Director, Solutions Engineering for SLED. This role owns the technical outcome for state and local government, education, and corrections across the United States and Canada. It is a leader of leaders role: you will build and run a multi-team organization through a year of significant growth, and the bar you set for hiring and technical quality is the one the whole vertical inherits.

This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 30% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

This role reports to the VP, Solutions Engineering.

About the Team

The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs. As Director you are the technical counterpart to the VP of SLED Sales, and you own the coverage model that pairs the two organizations together.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Lead the leaders

  • Recruit, hire, and develop Senior Managers, and create the path that takes strong Solutions Engineers into their first management role.

  • Hold each manager to a segment outcome rather than an activity count, and coach them on coaching.

  • Scale the organization without losing the bar. Hiring velocity in the first half of the year is the single largest execution risk in the plan.

  • Own the operating rhythm of the vertical: forecast reviews, capacity decisions, and the escalation path when demand for technical resources exceeds supply.

Drive technical wins

  • Own the technical win across all of SLED, and own the coverage model that pairs Solutions Engineering to the sales organization seat for seat. Defend it, or revise it with evidence, each planning cycle.

  • Partner with the VP of SLED Sales as the technical counterpart on segmentation, territory design, and headcount, and bring a defensible position rather than a request.

  • Represent SLED in forecast, planning, and executive reviews, and bring technical risk forward early rather than at the end of the quarter.

Own the SLED problem set

  • Own site assessment quality as a performance measure. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.

  • Hold the bar on proofs of concept: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.

  • Guide integration and airspace strategy — CAD and dispatch, video and evidence management, streaming platforms, BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and docked operations.

  • Maintain command of the public sector procurement path, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

Represent the customer inside Skydio

  • Be the aggregated voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Turn field observations into prioritized, defensible requirements rather than a list of one-off asks.

  • Build the enablement content, reference architectures, and reusable technical assets that let the team scale, and maintain first-hand product knowledge through frequent hands-on use.

What Makes You a Good Fit:

  • 8+ years of relevant technical experience, including time in a customer-facing technical role.

  • 2+ years leading leaders. A track record of managing managers, or of managing a team large enough to have required a second layer.

  • A record of building organizations through fast growth — hiring, onboarding, and retaining technical people at volume.

  • Strong understanding of drone technology, Public Safety sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance, including Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations.

  • Working knowledge of Public Safety technologies, including CAD, VMS, and related software platforms, and the ability to lead integration discussions.

  • Fluency in the commercial side of the business: coverage models, forecast discipline, deal strategy, and the judgment to know when to commit technical resources and when to decline.

  • Experience with state and local government procurement, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a senior executive without changing the facts.

  • Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.

Nice to Have

  • Prior public safety service as a sworn officer, firefighter, or agency UAS program lead.

  • Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.

  • Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.

  • Track record of building and scaling a technical team through a period of rapid growth.

What Is Required

  • Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.

What we’re building and why we’re building it. 

Fetch helps people live rewarded every day, with a vision to become the rewards destination for everyone. We turn everyday activities into meaningful rewards, whether it’s grocery shopping, grabbing a quick meal, or playing a favorite mobile game. To date, we’ve awarded more than $1 billion in Fetch Points to our users.

Each day, more than 13 million receipts are submitted on Fetch, providing visibility into over $212 billion in gross merchandise value. This creates the largest retail-agnostic, SKU-level view of household spending, powering Fetch as an outcomes-based advertising platform that helps brands acquire and retain lifelong consumers.

The Fetch app is available on the App Store and Google Play, with more than 6 million five-star reviews from a highly engaged and loyal user base.

It’s not just our users who believe in Fetch: with investments from Softbank, ICONIQ, DST, Greycroft, and partnerships ranging from challenger brands to Fortune 500 companies, Fetch is reshaping how brands and consumers connect in the marketplace. When you work at Fetch, you play a vital role in a platform that drives brand loyalty and creates lifelong consumers with the power of Fetch points. User and partner success are at the heart of everything we do, and we extend that same commitment to our employees.

At Fetch, we value curiosity, adaptability, and the confidence to explore new tools, especially AI, to drive smarter, faster work. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be ready to learn quickly and think critically. We welcome learners who move fast, challenge the status quo, and shape what’s next, with us.  Ranked as one of America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes for two years in a row, Fetch fosters a people-first culture rooted in trust, accountability, and innovation. We encourage our employees to challenge ideas, think bigger, and always bring the fun to Fetch.
About the Role:

Fetch is investing in dedicated enablement support for two important growth segments: Mid-Market, an established and rapidly expanding business, and SMB, a new business that is being built from the ground up.

We are seeking a Sales Enablement Manager to serve as the embedded enablement partner for both teams. This role will simplify how sellers understand and sell Fetch's packages, build and maintain segment-specific onboarding and playbooks, and create a repeatable go-to-market motion that helps new and existing sellers become productive faster.
This is a builder role for someone who can move between strategy and execution diagnosing what is getting in the way of performance, translating complex offerings into practical sales guidance, and partnering closely with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviors in the flow of work.

Reporting to the Director of Sales Enablement, this role will partner closely with the Director to translate the overall Sales Enablement strategy into an SMB and Mid-Market-specific roadmap. They will also work closely with a Sales Enablement Manager peer who leads broader programs and supports Fetch’s other verticals. Together, the team will preserve a consistent company-wide approach while ensuring MM and SMB needs are considered early and reflected wherever the sales motion requires a different approach.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

Responsibilities:

Segment Enablement Strategy & GTM Motion

  •  Serve as the primary enablement partner to SMB and Mid-Market Sales leaders, aligning priorities and enablement roadmaps to each segment's goals, seller needs, and stage of maturity.
  • Build and operationalize a clear, repeatable SMB sales motion while continuously evolving the Mid-Market motion as the team and opportunity set grow.
  • Translate business priorities into the processes, skills, messaging, tools, and reinforcement sellers need to execute consistently.
  • Use seller feedback, call insights, pipeline data, and performance trends to identify the highest-impact skill, process, and content gaps.

Onboarding, Ramp & Readiness

  • Take ownership of the customized Mid-Market onboarding already in development and continuously improve the end-to-end ramp experience for MM and future SMB sellers.
  • Build and maintain distinct learning paths for Mid-Market Growth, Mid-Market New Business, and future SMB roles, incorporating segment- and role-specific training, practice, certifications, and manager-led reinforcement.
  • Adapt shared onboarding content where the MM/SMB motion differs—for example, cold outreach and discovery for new business, segment-specific package details, and more accessible entry points.
  • Partner with frontline managers to define readiness expectations and ensure a consistent handoff from formal onboarding into in-role coaching.
  • Track time-to-readiness and time-to-productivity, using results to improve the ramp experience and remove friction for new hires.

Sales Packages, Playbooks & Training

  • Partner with GTM, Product Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations to simplify Fetch's products and packages into clear, sellable solutions for SMB and Mid-Market customers.
  • Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of every required MM/SMB version of broader training, package guidance, pitch decks, playbooks, talk tracks, and seller tools.
  • Translate shared offerings into the right MM/SMB execution—including package variances and more accessible entry levels, cold-outreach and new-business discovery motions, segment-relevant positioning, and role-specific pitch guidance.
  • Build practical segment playbooks that include buyer needs, outreach and discovery guidance, positioning, talk tracks, package selection, objection handling, proof points, measurement guidance, and execution steps.
  • Develop and facilitate targeted live and on-demand training for ramped and unramped sellers, grounded in real opportunities and the skills most likely to improve performance.
  • Convert launches and one-time trainings into reusable learning, coaching tools, and reinforcement that drive sustained adoption and behavior change.
  • Maintain accurate, easy-to-use segment content in Letter AI in partnership with the broader enablement content owner and established governance standards.

Enablement Peer & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with the Sales Enablement Manager serving other verticals to co-plan the roadmap, preserve consistent core messaging and methods, and identify MM/SMB versioning needs before broader programs are finalized.
  • Operate from shared standards and sources of truth rather than building a parallel enablement system; clearly divide ownership of core assets and MM/SMB adaptations.
  • Equip frontline managers with coaching guides, call-review frameworks, readiness checkpoints, and team exercises that reinforce the segment motion.
  • Develop deep working relationships with GTM partners responsible for product launches, media units, and Moments, representing MM/SMB requirements while plans, packages, and activation details are still being shaped.
  • Influence cross-functional plans so new products and activations have a compelling, executable fit for MM/SMB customers rather than requiring late-stage retrofitting.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, AIM, and other subject-matter experts to turn complex inputs into clear seller actions.
  • Create a reliable feedback loop between the field and cross-functional partners so messaging, packages, processes, and training improve as the businesses evolve.
  • Represent SMB and Mid-Market enablement needs in broader Sales Enablement planning while reusing shared programs and standards wherever they create scale.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track success measures for onboarding, training, package adoption, and seller proficiency, including leading and lagging indicators.
  • Track MM and SMB participation and completion across required trainings, following up with sellers and managers to close gaps and maintain clear visibility into readiness.
  • Monitor Gong adoption and use call reviews, manager observation, assessments, content usage, seller feedback, and commercial performance data to determine whether training is being applied in the field.
  • Use observed field behaviors to target reinforcement, coaching, content updates, and future training rather than treating completion as the finish line.
  • Use Letter AI, Gong, Salesforce, and AI-enabled workflows to improve learning, surface performance insights, and make enablement easier to access in the flow of work.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Training, or a comparable commercial role; experience supporting SMB and/or Mid-Market sales teams is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success building or improving onboarding, playbooks, training, coaching, or sales motions that produced measurable changes in seller performance.
  • Strong understanding of high-velocity SMB selling and consultative Mid-Market selling, with the judgment to tailor enablement to different cycle lengths, buyers, and levels of deal complexity.
  • Ability to simplify complex products, pricing, packaging, and processes into clear guidance sellers can confidently use with customers.
  • Experience using data and qualitative insights to diagnose performance gaps, prioritize programs, and measure impact.
  • Strong facilitation, coaching, program management, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to operate independently and build structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Experience with LMS/CMS platforms, CRM, conversation intelligence, and AI-enabled sales or learning tools.
  • Prior quota-carrying sales experience or meaningful experience coaching sellers in-role is strongly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, repeatable SMB sales motion is documented, taught, reinforced, and improved as the new team scales.
  • Customized onboarding and ramp paths for Mid-Market Growth, Mid-Market New Business, and future SMB roles remain current and help sellers reach meaningful readiness milestones faster.
  • Every broader enablement initiative that requires MM/SMB nuance has a clear, current segment version without creating conflicting narratives or disconnected systems.
  • Fetch's packages are easier for MM/SMB sellers to understand, select, position, and execute, with appropriate entry points and guidance for their buyers and sales motions.
  • MM/SMB requirements influence product launches, media units, and Moments early enough that the resulting plans are compelling and executable for the segments.
  • Training completion and Gong-based field application are visible, with managers receiving timely follow-up and reinforcement support.
  • Segment playbooks and training are trusted, current, and consistently used in live selling situations.
  • Enablement priorities are driven by measurable performance needs, with visible improvement in proficiency, adoption, conversion, deal velocity, or other agreed commercial outcomes.

data.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders,soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

Skydio is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineering leader to join our team as Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering for SLED Small Cities. The motion is transactional and high volume, coverage runs at one Solutions Engineer to two Key Account Leaders, and the agencies are small enough that a single well-run demonstration often decides the outcome.

This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 30% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

This role reports to the Director, Solutions Engineering – SLED.

About the Team:

The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Lead the team

  • Hire, onboard, coach, and retain your team, with clear ownership and coverage across the territories in your segment, and develop people beyond the seat they are in.

  • Set the bar for technical quality — demos, trial plans, site assessments, and customer-facing documentation that hold up in front of a chief, a sheriff, or a city council.

  • Own capacity across your segment. Decide where Solutions Engineering time goes, say no when it needs to be said, and make the tradeoffs visible to leadership.

Drive technical wins

  • Own the technical win across a two to one coverage model. Leverage is the job, and what cannot be templated, recorded, or reused will not scale here.

  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point on critical pursuits, deployments, and customer issues. Jump in and work the problem yourself, and be in the field when it matters.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline, forecast, and account planning, and on the land-and-expand motion that turns a first dock into a citywide program.

Own the Small Cities problem set

  • Stand the team up. Most of the seats are open, the operating model does not exist yet, and much of the segment is carried by Inside Sales working remote first.

  • Own site assessment quality as a performance measure. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.

  • Hold the bar on proofs of concept: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.

  • Guide integration and airspace strategy — CAD and dispatch, video and evidence management, streaming platforms, BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and docked operations.

  • Maintain command of the public sector procurement path, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

Represent the customer inside Skydio

  • Be the aggregated voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Turn field observations into prioritized, defensible requirements rather than a list of one-off asks.

  • Build the enablement content, reference architectures, and reusable technical assets that let the team scale, and maintain first-hand product knowledge through frequent hands-on use.

What Makes You a Good Fit:

  • 5+ years of relevant technical experience, including time in a customer-facing technical role (solutions engineering, field engineering, or applications engineering).

  • 1+ years leading a technical team, formally or as a technical lead with hiring and mentorship responsibility. First-time managers with a demonstrated record of leading and developing people will be considered.

  • Strong understanding of drone technology, Public Safety sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance, including Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations.

  • Working knowledge of Public Safety technologies, including CAD, VMS, and related software platforms, and the ability to lead integration discussions.

  • A track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing technical people, and of keeping them.

  • Comfort operating inside a Sales organization, including owning a quota, deal strategy, and the judgment to know when to commit technical resources and when to decline.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a senior executive without changing the facts.

  • Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior public safety service as a sworn officer, firefighter, or agency UAS program lead.

  • Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.

  • Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.

  • Track record of building and scaling a technical team through a period of rapid growth.

What Is Required:

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions

  • Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time.

  • Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $172,000 - 215,000* plus commission. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

#LI-AY1

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

The Senior Partner Success Implementation Engineer is a senior-level technical expert who plays a critical role in driving partner success across implementation, readiness, and ongoing product adoption. This role provides advanced technical expertise, leads escalated troubleshooting, influences product direction through enhancement advocacy, and ensures partners are fully enabled to deploy, configure, and optimize the platform at scale.

As a senior resource, this role also mentors junior engineers, provides strategic technical guidance to Partner Success Managers and TAMs, and contributes to technical leadership across the partner ecosystem.

How will you make an impact

Technical Advocacy & Product Support

· Deliver expert-level technical guidance, troubleshooting, and platform knowledge to partner customers following readiness.

· Champion product enhancements, representing complex partner needs and collaborating with internal engineering and product teams.

· Lead high-visibility or escalated support engagements to ensure timely resolution and optimal platform performance.

Implementation Leadership

· Oversee complex technical implementation projects for partner customers, including advanced configuration, integrations, deployment architecture, and onboarding strategies.

· Ensure partners understand scalable deployment models, technical best practices, and long-term operational success strategies.

· Guide handoff from implementation to steady-state support while ensuring smooth transition for partners and internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Serve as a senior liaison to TAM and Partner Success organizations, ensuring deep technical alignment across partner and customer support motions.

· Collaborate with Partner Success Managers to assess partner maturity, identify technical gaps, and drive adoption strategies.

· Communicate product updates, platform changes, and technical insights across partner-facing teams, influencing broader operational excellence.

Knowledge Sharing & Best Practices

· Create and share advanced best practices, technical playbooks, and lessons learned across partner accounts.

· Lead internal knowledge-sharing sessions, mentor Implementation Engineers, and elevate the technical capabilities of the Partner Success organization.

· Contribute to scalable enablement content, documentation, and training material to enhance partner readiness and technical proficiency.

· Lead executive business reviews and represent partner technical needs in strategic planning forums.

Have you got what it takes?

· 5-7 years of experience in implementation engineering, solutions engineering, technical support, or a related technical customer facing role.

· Strong expertise in diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues across integrations, APIs, configuration, and deployment environments.

· Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts for diverse audiences.

· Proven ability to lead technical projects, influence stakeholders, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

· Ability to travel up to 20% regional travel; some international travel may be necessary to meet with partners, attend business reviews, and support regional initiatives.

You will have an advantage if you also have:

· Experience partnering with channel or reseller organizations

· Experience in a global technology or SaaS organization. Professional services, or Solution Delivery

· Deep knowledge of global partner ecosystems or channel/alliances strategy.

· Familiarity with cloud architectures, API ecosystems, or enterprise deployment patterns.
